metadata.step: STEP 7 — Satellite Land-Change / Deformation Data Pipeline
metadata.search_api: ASF DAAC SearchAPI (NASA Alaska Satellite Facility)

search_parameters.spatial_resolution_note: ~10 m pixel spacing (GRDH). When aggregated to the 500 m analysis grid, this is a zonal statistic, NOT 500 m measurement resolution.

metadata.scientific_notice: SAR change signals derived from these scenes are CORROBORATING ANOMALY EVIDENCE only. They must NEVER be automatically labelled as landslides. A human/officer verification layer is required.
